name: flinttrade-monorepo
//: pnpm settings, overrides and peerDependencyRules all live in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which is the
single source of truth from pnpm 10 onwards. The `pnpm` field that used to sit here was removed
in the 9.15.0 -> 10.34.5 migration: pnpm 11 ignores it outright, and keeping a second copy in
two files that disagree about precedence is how the earlier override drift happened.
Do NOT reintroduce a `pnpm` key here - add the setting to pnpm-workspace.yaml instead.
